title: Plan: resetAvailable auto-assign can write a five-digit negative Assigned into a card payment category
notes:
Root cause: client/src/domain/auto-assign.ts resetAvailable builds 'at(c.assigned, month) - c.available' for EVERY category, card payment categories included. When a payment envelope's Available is a large positive (money budgeted toward old card debt), accepting the strategy writes assigned - available, i.e. a five-digit negative into the payment row. Production evidence: 'Itau Cartao' Assigned -97.235,07 with Available 0,00. The engine is faithful there: BudgetMonth.payments[id].assigned is the stored assignment (client/src/domain/zeroSum.ts, payment loop: assignedIn(id, m)), so the number comes from the write side. Proposed fix: bound the reset by the I2 relationship for payment categories (never below -max(0, debt)), or exclude payment categories from resetAvailable.
Production evidence (budget Casa b35979ff, read-only dump 2026-11-27): the negative Assigned is STORED data, not a display artifact — 33 of the 34 assignment rows in 2026-11 are negative, totalling -R$511.090,37 ('Itau Cartão' -97.235,07, 'Reforma Parte Externa' -165.375,42, 'Gastos - Gabriele' -73.403,00, 31 more). Shape is exactly 'reset available': each row's negative equals that category's leftover Available from the prior month (assigned -165.375,42 with activity 0,00 lands Available on 0,00). So a budget-wide reset-ahead, not only resetAvailable on a payment category. Never derived by the engine: PaymentMonth.assigned = the stored assignment row (zeroSum.ts assignedIn); the engine only surfaces debt/underfunded separately.
